records.statement: GasGas EC 450F 2024 owner's manual troubleshooting - The engine cannot be cranked (starter motor): operating error, 12-V battery discharged, main fuse blown, starter relay defective, starter motor defective; The engine turns but does not start: operating error, quick release coupling not joined, fuse 1 blown, fuse 4 blown, idle speed is not set correctly, spark plug sooty or wet, plug gap of spark plug too wide, ignition system defective, short-circuit cable in wiring harness frayed, stop button or emergency OFF switch faulty, error in the electronic fuel injection; Engine does not speed up: error in the electronic fuel injection, ignition system defective; Engine has too little power: air filter heavily contaminated, fuel filter is very dirty, fuel screen is very dirty, error in the electronic fuel injection, exhaust system leaky, deformed or too little glass fiber yarn filling in the main silencer, valve clearance too little, ignition system defective; The engine dies during the trip: lack of fuel, fuse 1 blown, fuse 4 blown; Values in combination instrument deleted (time, stop watch, lap times) The high beam, low beam, tail light, position light, and license plate lamp are not working The horn, brake light, turn signal, and radiator fan are not working: the combination instrument bat- tery is empty, fuse 2 blown, fuse 3 blown.

records.topic: owner's manual coverage and intended use
records.statement: GASGAS's 2021 owner's manual (art. no. 3215010en) covers MC 450F, EX 450F. For the EX 450F it states: This vehicle has been designed and built to withstand the normal stresses and strains of racing. Only operate this vehicle in closed-off areas remote from public road traffic. This vehicle is designed for use in offroad endurance competition, and not primarily for use in motocross.

records.statement: Husqvarna FE 450 2020 owner's manual troubleshooting - The engine cannot be cranked (starter motor): operating error, 12-V battery discharged, main fuse blown, starter relay defective, starter motor defective; The engine turns but does not start: operating error, the plug-in connection of the fuel hose connection is not connected, fuse 1 blown, fuse 4 blown, idle speed is not set correctly, spark plug oily or wet, plug gap of spark plug too wide, ignition system defective, short-circuit cable in wiring harness frayed, switch-off button or emergency OFF switch faulty, error in the electronic fuel injection; Engine does not speed up: error in the electronic fuel injection, ignition system defective; Engine has too little power: air filter heavily contaminated, fuel filter is very dirty, fuel screen is very dirty, error in the electronic fuel injection; Engine has too little power: exhaust system leaky, deformed or too little glass fiber yarn filling in the main silencer, valve clearance too little, ignition system defective; The engine dies during the trip: lack of fuel, fuse 1 blown, fuse 4 blown.

records.statement: Worked out from the stock gearing and the 110/100-18 rear tire: about 7.1, 8.5, 10.1, 11.9, 14.1 km/h per 1,000 rpm in gears 1-5 (4.4, 5.3, 6.3, 7.4, 8.8 mph), so the gearing spread decides how far each gear pulls.

records.topic: race set-up used by testers (2020 FX 450)
records.statement: A test-team set-up for the 2020 FX 450: fork air at the stock 146 psi (about 10 bar), compression 3-17 clicks depending on speed, rebound 10 out (stock 12), forks at the third line; shock spring 45 N/mm, race sag 105 mm (some used 107 mm with forks raised 2 mm), high-speed compression 1-3/4 turns out, low-speed 15 out, rebound 12 out. records.statement: KTM's 2020 owner's manual (art. no. 3214004en) covers 350 SX-F, 350 XC-F. For the 350 XC-F it states: This vehicle has been designed and built to withstand the normal stresses and strains of racing. Only operate this vehicle in closed-off areas remote from public road traffic. This vehicle is designed for use in offroad endurance competition, and not primarily for use in motocross.

records.statement: KTM 450 XC-F 2020-2022: when the malfunction indicator lamp flashes, the manual's blink codes point to the faulty sensor or circuit - 02 = Crankshaft speed sensor circuit; 06 = Throttle valve position sensor circuit A circuit; 09 = Induction manifold pressure sensor circuit; 12 = Coolant temperature sensor circuit; 13 = Intake air temperature sensor circuit; 15 = Tilt sensor; 21 = Battery voltage input voltage too high; 22 = Gear position sensor circuit; 33 = Injection valve cylinder 1 circuit; 37 = Ignition coil circuit; 41 = Fuel pump controller short circuit to ground/open circuit; 65 = EEPROM malfunction.

source.name: KTM owner's manual 2022 450 SX-F / 450 XC-F (art. no. 3214418en)

records.notes: Codes are read as long/short flashes (e.g. 12 = 1 long, 2 short); the dealer diagnostics tool reads the full fault memory. Same values printed in each year's owner's manual (2020: 3214032en; 2021: 3214217en; 2022: 3214418en); source shown is the latest.

records.topic: road speed per 1,000 rpm by gear (derived)
records.statement: Worked out from the stock gearing and the 110/100-18 rear tire: about 5.9, 8.1, 10.3, 12.8, 14.6, 18.8 km/h per 1,000 rpm in gears 1-6 (3.7, 5.0, 6.4, 8.0, 9.0, 11.7 mph), so the gearing spread decides how far each gear pulls.

records.notes: Nominal tire diameter 677 mm from the size code (rim + 2 x section height), circumference 2.127 m; real rolling radius under load is smaller, so true speeds run a few percent lower.

not_found: Husqvarna FE 450 2020-2022 as a US model: the owner's manuals list only FE 450 EU and FE 501 US variants (VIN type tables), so the FE 450 figures recorded for those years are the EU model's. From 2023 the manual lists an FE 450 US.

Husqvarna FX 450 2025 and GasGas EX 450F 2025 in the US catalog: both 2025 owner's manuals list a US type code (FX 450 US F2375Y4, EX 450F US F0275Y1), but the FX 450 is missing from Husqvarna's 2025 line-up release and the 2025 EX 450F is not on the 2025 US front-caliper recall list. No US price list, dealer listing or spec page for either was found, so US availability stays unconfirmed. Neither model appears in the 2026 line-ups.
Husqvarna FX 350 2025 chassis data: the 2025 FC 350/FX 350 manual prints weight, final drive, tires and tank rows for FC only; FX-specific chassis values not found.
GasGas EX 450F 2021 gearbox type and ratios: the 2021 MC 450F/EX 450F manual leaves the Gearbox and Transmission-ratio rows blank.

Enduro-format service schedules (KTM 450 XCF-W 2023, Husqvarna FE 450 2020-2023): the recommended-work table columns (engine service, fuel filter, brake fluid) could not be aligned to their hour headings in the PDF text, so only oil, valve, air-filter, silencer and suspension intervals were recorded.

KTM-branded recalls or service bulletins for 250/350/450 XC-F and 450 XCF-W 2020-2027: none found on the US CPSC pages or NHTSA-indexed TSB lists searched (the 2025 and 2026 caliper recalls cover only Husqvarna and GASGAS).

Torque tables in the 2025-2027 manual format: axle, triple-clamp and shock-bolt rows carry model qualifiers on separate lines; only unambiguous rows (oil drain, spark plug, clutch hub, rotor, sprocket nuts, swingarm pivot, caliper, disc, spokes) were recorded for those years.
Measured (scale) weights for the assigned bikes outside the existing records: not published in the tests read.
